scope: HBC holdings in five northern North American State Regions
authorization: Latest direct player request 2026-10-25; does not validate or advance the separate Balkan/SERG trackers

rules.decision: No isolated outposts: connect every retained post to the main territory through a narrow continuous corridor of same-country provinces, and verify actual market access and supply in game
rules.historical_status: Gameplay representation constraint, not evidence of historical control along the corridor

rules.decision: Localized posts and directly held installations, not the entire drainage basin
Record territorial and governing claims as well as exclusive commerce; do not infer effective control
Represent local societies; no automatic empty territory or single centralized Inuit polity
European geographic uncertainty is independent of ownership, occupation and claims

sectors.decision: Reject whole-state effective HBC administration inferred from charter
sectors.candidate_holders: Inuit communities and other local peoples in southern parts of this game State Region
sectors.do_not_do: Do not simply transfer all provinces to existing centralized NNV or to ATB

sectors.decision: Separate York/Churchill post nuclei from Indigenous hinterlands; do not retroject Red River Colony 1812
Keep Cumberland House as localized HBC establishment; map Cree/Assiniboine and other local territories separately
Localize Moose/Albany/Henley and other confirmed posts; distinguish hinterlands and Quebec jurisdictions
Localize Eastmain and other confirmed eastern James Bay establishments; resolve Rupert House reopening in 1776

posts.name: Prince of Wales / Churchill
posts.basis: Parks Canada stone fort chronology beginning 1732

posts.name: Moose Factory
posts.basis: Parks Canada designation: reoccupied 1730 and supplying posts in 1770s

posts.name: Cumberland House
posts.basis: Parks Canada: founded 1774; no intervening closure established

posts.name: Albany
posts.basis: Existing old post and HBCA fonds B.3; not a verified 1776 perimeter

posts.name: Henley House
posts.basis: Compiled reference to 1774 journals; conflicting foundation/rebuilding years; direct journal not read

posts.name: Eastmain
posts.basis: MG20-B59 journal series 1736-1908; range not proof of every year

posts.name: Severn
posts.basis: HBCA B.198 identification; multi-period map does not prove 1776 operation

posts.name: Rupert House / Waskaganish
posts.basis: Federal community sheet indexed excerpt gives 1776; exact opening date missing
posts.do_not_do: Do not automatically initialize active HBC post on January 1 based on 1668 foundation

geometry_blockers: No historically validated post-to-RGB correspondence in reused R8 dossiers
Existing MAP1 pixel atlas has no established GPS/historical georeferencing
European georeferencing default controls do not independently validate northern Canada
Post control footprint and Indigenous political allocations cannot be derived from a point radius
State-wide native add_claim does not express fine watershed boundaries
